```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/Bruger/Desktop/WIMD-Rural-deprivation-wales")

master <- read_csv("data/processed/master_dataset.csv", show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
  mutate(rural_urban = factor(rural_urban, levels=c("Rural","Urban")))

rural <- filter(master, rural_urban == "Rural")
urban <- filter(master, rural_urban == "Urban")

N   <- nrow(master)
T20 <- floor(N * 0.20)   # worst 20% rank threshold
T10 <- floor(N * 0.10)   # worst 10% rank threshold
B20 <- N - T20           # best 20% boundary

NEVER <- "LSOAs never ranked in top 50 most deprived"

tibble(check = c("Rows","Rural","Urban","Worst 20% ≤","Worst 10% ≤"),
       value = c(N, nrow(rural), nrow(urban), T20, T10))

```

```{r}
# One helper does everything. Takes a data frame and a column NAME (string).
pct_worst20 <- function(df, col) round(100 * mean(df[[col]] <= T20, na.rm=TRUE), 1)
pct_best20  <- function(df, col) round(100 * mean(df[[col]] >  B20, na.rm=TRUE), 1)

# Domain reference table — column names, plain labels, published weights
DOM <- tribble(
  ~col,                    ~label,        ~weight,
  "income_rank",           "Income",        22,
  "employment_rank",       "Employment",    20,
  "health_rank",           "Health",        15,
  "education_rank",        "Education",     14,
  "access_rank",           "Access",        10,
  "housing_rank",          "Housing",        9,
  "community_safety_rank", "Safety",         5,
  "physical_env_rank",     "Phys Env",       5
)

```





```{r theme}
RED  <- "#C0392B"; BLUE <- "#2471A3"; ORG <- "#E67E22"
PUR  <- "#7D3C98"; GRY  <- "#333333"; BG  <- "#FFFFFF"

TH <- theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill=BG, colour=NA),
        panel.background= element_rect(fill=BG, colour=NA),
        panel.grid      = element_blank(),
        axis.line       = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
        plot.title      = element_text(face="bold", size=13, colour="#111111",
                                       margin=margin(b=3)),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size=9.5, colour="#52514E",
                                       margin=margin(b=8), lineheight=1.4),
        plot.caption    = element_text(size=7.5, colour="#898781", hjust=0,
                                       margin=margin(t=6)),
        plot.margin     = margin(14,18,10,14),
        axis.text       = element_text(size=9.5, colour="#444444"),
        axis.title      = element_text(size=9.5, colour="#444444"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.5,"cm"),
        legend.text     = element_text(size=9.5, colour="#52514E"),
        legend.title    = element_blank())

dir.create("outputs", showWarnings=FALSE)
sv  <- function(p, f, h=5) ggsave(file.path("outputs",f), p, width=9, height=h, dpi=150, bg=BG)
PCT <- function(x) paste0(x,"%")
SRC <- "Source: WIMD 2025 (Welsh Government); RUC 2021 (ONS). n=1,917 Welsh LSOAs."

```

```{r}
# For each domain, is the rural %worst20 higher or lower than the urban %worst20?
c2_side <- DOM %>%
  mutate(rural_pct = map_dbl(col, ~ pct_worst20(rural, .x)),
         urban_pct = map_dbl(col, ~ pct_worst20(urban, .x)),
         side      = if_else(rural_pct > urban_pct,
                             "Rural deprivation higher",
                             "Urban deprivation higher"))
c2_side %>% select(label, weight, rural_pct, urban_pct, side)

c2 <- c2_side %>%
  count(side, wt = weight, name = "weight")
c2

```


```{r}
p2 <- c2 %>%
  mutate(side = factor(side, levels = c("Rural deprivation higher",
                                        "Urban deprivation higher"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = weight, y = "WIMD score", fill = side)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.45, colour = BG, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = PCT(weight)), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 10, fontface = "bold", colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rural deprivation higher" = RED,
                               "Urban deprivation higher" = BLUE)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), labels = PCT) +
  labs(title    = "WIMD weighting highlights urban deprivation while masking rural deprivation",
       subtitle = paste0(
         "Weighting means each domain contributes a fixed share of the final score.\n",
         "Access + housing (where rural is worse) = ",
         c2$weight[c2$side == "Rural deprivation higher"], "% of the score.\n",
         "The six urban-worse domains = ",
         c2$weight[c2$side == "Urban deprivation higher"], "%."),
       x = "Share of the total WIMD score (%)", y = NULL,
       caption = "Weights: WIMD 2025 technical report. Side derived from the data.") +
  TH + theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),                 # unchanged — y has no real labels
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 16),          # was 13
    plot.subtitle= element_text(size = 12.5),        # was 9.5
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11.5),        # was 9.5
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12)           # was 9.5
  )
p2; sv(p2, "c2_weight_structure.png", h = 3.8)

```

```{r}
c1 <- DOM %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(col = "wimd_2025_rank", label = "Overall WIMD", weight = NA)) %>%
  mutate(rural_pct = map_dbl(col, ~ pct_worst20(rural, .x)),
         urban_pct = map_dbl(col, ~ pct_worst20(urban, .x)),
         gap       = round(rural_pct - urban_pct, 1),
         axis      = if_else(is.na(weight), label, paste0(label, " (", weight, "%)")))
c1 %>% select(label, weight, rural_pct, urban_pct, gap) %>% arrange(desc(gap))

```


```{r}
p1 <- c1 %>%
  mutate(axis = fct_reorder(axis, gap)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gap, y = axis, fill = gap > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = BG, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.7, colour = "#BBBBBB") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(if_else(gap > 0, "+", ""), gap, "%"),
                hjust = if_else(gap > 0, -0.15, 1.12)),
            size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", colour = "#111111") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = RED, `FALSE` = BLUE), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(c1$gap) - 8, max(c1$gap) + 11),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(if_else(x > 0, "+", ""), x, "%")) +
  labs(title    = "Rural areas score worse on some domains. Urban areas score worse on most.",
       subtitle = "Red = rural areas more often in the worst 20% of Wales. Blue = urban areas more often.",
       x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = SRC) +
  TH
p1; sv(p1, "c1_all_domain_gaps.png")

```

```{r}
# Urban example: the most income-deprived urban LSOA
```

```{r}
# One bar per domain, one colour per LSOA — same visual grammar as C8's
# LA comparison, applied at the individual-community level.
rural_name <- c2b$lsoa[1]; urban_name <- c2b$lsoa[2]

p2b <- c2b %>%
  pivot_longer(-lsoa, names_to = "domain", values_to = "rank") %>%
  mutate(domain = factor(domain, levels = ALLDOM$label),
         lsoa   = factor(lsoa, levels = c2b$lsoa)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = domain, y = rank, fill = lsoa)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.72, colour = BG, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(rank, big.mark = ",")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
            vjust = -0.35, size = 2.9, fontface = "bold", colour = "#111111") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c(RED, BLUE), c2b$lsoa)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, N * 1.08),
                     breaks = c(1, T20, B20, N),
                     labels = c("1 (most deprived)", paste0(T20," (worst 20%)"),
                                paste0(B20," (best 20%)"), format(N,big.mark=","))) +
  labs(title    = "Why weighting matters: two real Welsh communities, all 8 domains",
       subtitle = paste0(
         "RURAL AREAS ONLY vs URBAN — one community each, every WIMD domain shown\n",
         rural_name, " is rural: near-worst in Wales for access, near-best for everything else.\n",
         urban_name, " is urban: worst in Wales for income, employment, health and safety."),
       x = NULL, y = "WIMD rank (lower = more deprived)", caption = SRC) +
  TH + theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),                 # unchanged — y has no real labels
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 16),          # was 13
    plot.subtitle= element_text(size = 12.5),        # was 9.5
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11.5),        # was 9.5
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12)           # was 9.5
  )
p2b; sv(p2b, "c2b_two_communities.png", h = 5.5)
```

```{r}
# For each rank column: find the 50 smallest ranks, count how many are rural.
# Base-R indexing (order + [[ ) avoids tidy-eval lazy-evaluation problems
# that occur when a column name is passed as a variable into dplyr verbs
# nested inside map_int().
top50_rural_count <- function(col_name) {
  ranked_order <- order(master[[col_name]])   # row positions, smallest rank first
  top50_rows   <- ranked_order[1:50]
  sum(master$rural_urban[top50_rows] == "Rural")
}

c4 <- DOM %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(col = "wimd_2025_rank", label = "Overall WIMD", weight = NA)) %>%
  mutate(rural = vapply(col, top50_rural_count, integer(1)),
         urban = 50L - rural,
         axis  = if_else(is.na(weight), label, paste0(label, "\n(", weight, "%)")))
c4 %>% select(label, weight, rural, urban)

```



```{r}
LAS <- c("Powys", "Ceredigion", "Pembrokeshire", "Swansea")

# Compute each %worst20 directly — no cur_data_all(), no fragile helpers
c8 <- master %>%
  filter(la_name %in% LAS) %>%
  group_by(la_name) %>%
  summarise(n          = n(),
            Overall    = round(100 * mean(wimd_2025_rank  <= T20), 1),
            Income     = round(100 * mean(income_rank     <= T20), 1),
            Employment = round(100 * mean(employment_rank <= T20), 1),
            Access     = round(100 * mean(access_rank     <= T20), 1),
            Housing    = round(100 * mean(housing_rank    <= T20), 1),
            .groups    = "drop") %>%
  mutate(la_name = factor(la_name, levels = LAS)) %>%
  arrange(la_name)
c8

```


```{r}

c7_groups <- rural %>%
  mutate(income_dep = income_rank <= T20,
         access_dep = access_rank <= T20,
         grp = case_when(
           income_dep &  access_dep ~ "Income and access deprived",
           income_dep & !access_dep ~ "Income deprived only",
          !income_dep &  access_dep ~ "Access deprived only",
           TRUE                     ~ "Neither"),
         col = case_when(
           income_dep &  access_dep ~ PUR,
           income_dep & !access_dep ~ BLUE,
          !income_dep &  access_dep ~ RED,
           TRUE                     ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  group_by(grp, col) %>%
  summarise(n           = n(),
            visible_n   = sum(wimd_2025_rank <= T20),
            visible_pct = round(100 * mean(wimd_2025_rank <= T20), 1),
            .groups     = "drop")
c7_groups

  filter(grp != "Neither") %>%
  mutate(grp = factor(grp, levels = c("Income deprived only",
                                      "Income and access deprived",
                                      "Access deprived only")))

# Fails immediately, at the point of creation — not three chunks
# later inside a ggplot call
stopifnot(!any(is.na(c7$col)))
c7 %>% select(grp, n, visible_pct, col)
```

```{r}
  ggplot(aes(x = rural_urban, y = pct_hidden, fill = rural_urban)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.44, colour = BG, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = PCT(pct_hidden), colour = rural_urban),
            vjust = -0.35, size = 13, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Rural = RED, Urban = BLUE), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Rural = RED, Urban = BLUE), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 95), labels = PCT, breaks = seq(0, 75, 25)) +
  labs(title    = "Most rural areas score worse on access than their overall WIMD rank suggests",
       subtitle = paste0("The typical rural area sits ",
                         abs(c3$median_gap[c3$rural_urban == "Rural"]),
                         " rank positions lower on access than on its overall score."),
       x = NULL, y = "% of areas whose access rank is worse than their overall rank",
       caption = SRC) +
  TH + theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),                 # unchanged — y has no real labels
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 16),          # was 13
    plot.subtitle= element_text(size = 12.5),        # was 9.5
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11.5),        # was 9.5
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12)           # was 9.5
  )
p3; sv(p3, "c3_access_rank_gap.png")
```

```{r}
p6 <- c6 %>%
  mutate(lab = paste0(group, "\n(", n, " areas)")) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Income, Access), names_to = "domain", values_to = "rank") %>%
  mutate(domain = factor(domain, levels = c("Income", "Access"),
                         labels = c("Income rank (22%)", "Access rank (10%)"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lab, y = rank, fill = domain)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.54, colour = BG, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(rank, big.mark = ",")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.54),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3.8, fontface = "bold", colour = "#111111") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Income rank (22%)" = BLUE,
                               "Access rank (10%)" = RED)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, N * 0.75),
                     breaks = c(1, T20, round(N/2), 1150), labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title    = "Never-tracked rural areas and deep-rooted urban areas — mirror-image profiles",
       subtitle = "Never-tracked rural: comfortable on income, severely deprived on access. Urban deep-rooted: the reverse.",
       x = NULL, y = "Median rank (lower = more deprived)", caption = SRC) +
  TH
p6; sv(p6, "c6_drd_profiles.png")
```

```{r}
cer <- filter(master, la_name == "Ceredigion")

ab_pts <- cer %>% filter(str_detect(lsoa_name, "Aberystwyth")) %>%
  transmute(group = "Aberystwyth (town)", access_rank)
ru_pts <- cer %>% filter(rural_urban == "Rural") %>%
  transmute(group = "Rural Ceredigion", access_rank)
c9 <- bind_rows(ab_pts, ru_pts)

# What the old median hid: individual ranks in each group
sort(ab_pts$access_rank)
sort(ru_pts$access_rank)

# Simple counts instead of an average — easy to state, nothing to explain
c9 %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), in_worst20 = sum(access_rank <= T20), .groups = "drop")


```


```{r}
ab_n   <- sum(c9$group == "Aberystwyth (town)")
ru_n   <- sum(c9$group == "Rural Ceredigion")
ab_bad <- sum(c9$group == "Aberystwyth (town)" & c9$access_rank <= T20)
ru_bad <- sum(c9$group == "Rural Ceredigion"   & c9$access_rank <= T20)

set.seed(1)  # fixed seed so the jitter looks the same every time this runs

p9 <- c9 %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Aberystwyth (town)", "Rural Ceredigion"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = access_rank, colour = group)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0, ymax = T20,
           fill = RED, alpha = 0.08) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = T20, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 3.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Aberystwyth (town)" = BLUE, "Rural Ceredigion" = RED), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, N), labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title    = "Inside one local authority: town and rural areas are far apart on access",
       subtitle = paste0(
         "Each dot is one real neighbourhood. The shaded band marks the worst 20% for access in Wales.\n",
         ab_bad, " of ", ab_n, " Aberystwyth neighbourhoods fall in that band. ",
         ru_bad, " of ", ru_n, " rural Ceredigion neighbourhoods do."),
       x = NULL, y = "Access rank (1 = most deprived, 1,917 = least deprived)",
       caption = SRC) +
  TH + theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),                 # unchanged — y has no real labels
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 16),          # was 13
    plot.subtitle= element_text(size = 12.5),        # was 9.5
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11.5),        # was 9.5
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12)           # was 9.5
  )
p9; sv(p9, "c9_within_ceredigion.png")
```

```{r}
c10 <- master %>%
  mutate(access_group = if_else(access_rank <= T20,
                                "Poor access to services",
                                "Normal access to services"),
         access_group = factor(access_group,
                        levels = c("Poor access to services",
                                  "Normal access to services"))) %>%
  group_by(rural_urban, access_group) %>%
  summarise(n           = n(),
            healthy_n   = sum(health_rank > B20),
            pct_healthy = round(100 * healthy_n / n, 1),
            .groups     = "drop")
c10
```

```{r}


p10 <- c10 %>%

  )
```

```{r}
dual <- rural %>% filter(access_rank <= T20, housing_rank <= T20)
tibble(check = c("dual-deprived rural areas", "of which visible in worst 20% overall"),
       value = c(nrow(dual), sum(dual$wimd_2025_rank <= T20)))

c12 <- dual %>%
  count(la_name, name = "n") %>%
  left_join(count(rural, la_name, name = "rural_total"), by = "la_name") %>%
  mutate(pct_of_rural = round(100 * n / rural_total, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% slice_head(n = 8)
c12

```

```{r}
p12 <- c12 %>%
  mutate(la_name = fct_reorder(la_name, n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = la_name)) +
  geom_col(fill = ORG, width = 0.65, colour = BG, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "  (", pct_of_rural, "% of rural areas)")),
            hjust = -0.05, size = 3.4, colour = "#111111") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max(c12$n) * 2.1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title    = paste0(nrow(dual),
         " rural areas: worst 20% for both access AND housing — none appear deprived overall"),
       subtitle = "Deprivation on both rural-worse domains, neither of the domains that drive the score.",
       x = "Number of areas", y = NULL,
       caption = paste0("Access rank ≤", T20, " and housing rank ≤", T20, ". ", SRC)) +
  TH
p12; sv(p12, "c12_dual_deprivation.png", h = 6)

```
